caption: The drawing consists of two outlined depictions of garments on a beige background. The main object is a detailed rendering of a full-length dress, shown in right profile with a high collar and long fitted sleeves. The dress has multiple horizontal bands of patterned trim or lace on the bodice, cuffs, skirt, and hem, with extra decorative trim running vertically down the side and outlining the overskirt drapery. The overskirt appears to be gathered or bunched to one side, revealing layered, flounced underskirts beneath. To the upper right of the central dress is a smaller, less detailed drawing of a bodice, shown front-facing, featuring crisscross seam lines, fitted waist, puffed or draped elements at the hips, and trim along the hem and around the collar. All elements of the drawing are rendered in fine, light lines without any shading, and the overall composition is monochromatic, remaining in the tones of the base paper and pencil or ink lines.
title: Dress
